builds.name: Supply Kill / Utility (TW, Rank)
builds.summary: Grab, Snare, Slash then shuriken to reduce other cooldowns; ultimate dismounts, snare cancels anything including CCi heroes.
builds.strongVs: Protecting exotics; defending supply on TW
builds.forWhom: Players swapping in temporarily for the utility window, then swapping back (e.g. to Longbow or Dual Blades)

techniques.name: Grab-Snare-Slash-Shuriken combo
techniques.rhythm: Only one combo: shurikens will reduce CD of your other spells.

gameplay.text: Your ultimate dismount enemy if they mounted, and ur snare cancel anything, even CCi heroes so you are great to protect important units such as exotics (low life, high impact units), you are great to defend supply on TW, the class isn't really played in sieges or ranked but rather used temporarily then swapping back to another class (LB or DB for example), or specially for TW.
